name: Negative Energy Flood

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: a broken bone and a square of black silk

summary: A creature you can see that isn't Undead makes a Constitution save: 3d10 + 25 Necrotic damage, half on a success. A Humanoid this kills rises at the start of your next turn as a Zombie that obeys you (in the game, for the rest of the fight). An Undead target instead gains 3d10 Temporary Hit Points. +1d10 damage per slot level above 5.
